scripts.difftest: python3 tools/difftest/extract_java_frames.py $DIFFTEST_TARGETS > /tmp/java_frames.json && node tools/difftest/emit_ts_frames.ts > /tmp/ts_frames.json && python3 tools/difftest/compare.py /tmp/java_frames.json /tmp/ts_frames.json
